name: Hoshi no Oujo 3 ~Ten-chi-jin no Souseiki~
original_name: 星の王女3～天・地・人の創世記～
source:
One day the university student protagonist had a strange dream. Somewhere she heard a voice. Somewhere she saw a face. She started feeling a twinge of a subconscious memory. A soundless voice led her to a hill of of cherry trees... Then a door of time opened.

The protagonist had waited to arrive at the world she caught a glimpse of in that dream... She met Heavenly beings and Earthly beings, as well as existences that were in-between. Were the meetings coincidence, or fate? Why am I here?

Those questions piled up in her mind the more she connected with these men. Heaven, Earth, People... Various hidden feelings and unsent thoughts caused a war to start. In order to get closer to the feelings of the people she believed in, the protagonist got caught up in the fighting. The thing that could be found at the end of the fight were the answers to those questions. As well as...

A variety of ways of love are depicted in this old style romance tale mixed with a fantastical tale of the gods. This story will softly ignite your heart. Who will you walk with past the door of time?

[Translated from the [url=http://www.mirai-soft.com/hosi3/intro-3.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
一天，身为大学生的主人公做了一个奇怪的梦。她仿佛在某处听见了声音，也在某处看见了一张面孔，潜意识中的一段记忆开始隐隐刺痛。一道无声之声引领她走向长满樱树的山丘…随后，时间之门开启了。

主人公来到梦中曾短暂窥见的世界。她遇见了天人、地人，以及介于二者之间的存在。这些相遇究竟是偶然，还是命运？我为什么会在这里？

她与那些男子的联系越深，心中的疑问便积累得越多。天、地、人…种种隐藏的情感与未能传达的思念，最终引发了一场战争。为了接近自己所信任之人的内心，主人公也被卷入战斗。战斗尽头等待着她的，是那些问题的答案，以及…

这是一部古风恋爱故事，并融入了充满神明色彩的幻想传说，描绘了各式各样的爱。这个故事将轻轻点燃你的心。跨过时间之门后，你会与谁携手同行？

[翻译自[url=http://www.mirai-soft.com/hosi3/intro-3.html]官方网站[/url]]
